deferredTools.summary: Browser automation: pages, clicks, forms, screenshots, console, network.
Web search, URL and repo fetching, and cited sources.
Datadog logs, metrics, traces, and other observability data.
Search past sessions, or this session's history and file writes.
Replace or remove a memory entry.
Create, update, view, or delete saved skills.
Message or stop a running subagent.
List, read, or stop background shell tasks.
Type-check and lint with the project's own checkers.

memory_add.description: Save a durable fact to persistent memory: a user correction or preference, an environment fact, or a project convention. Not for task progress or TODOs. Keep entries compact.

parameters.target: user: who the user is and their preferences. memory: global and environment facts. project: repo conventions. failure: lessons such as failures, corrections, insights, and tool quirks.

memory_replace.description: Replace a persistent memory entry, found by a substring of its text.

memory_search.description: Search persistent memory: user preferences, project conventions, past failures, and lessons. Each result shows the target that memory_replace and memory_remove need.

parameters.project: Project name to filter by, or null for global memories only.

ask_user_question.description: Ask the user one or more questions in an interactive form: radio (single choice), checkbox (multiple choice), or text. Radio and checkbox questions get an "Other" option by default. A blank "Other" answer means the user wants the question rephrased or split.
promptGuidelines: Use ask_user_question instead of plain-text questions when the user needs to choose or confirm something. Group related questions in one call.

parameters.title: Form title.
parameters.questions.label: Tab label; defaults to Q1, Q2, and so on.
parameters.questions.options.label: Display label.
parameters.questions.allowOther: Add an Other option with text input; default true.
parameters.questions.allowComment: Add an optional comment row; default false.
parameters.questions.required: Whether an answer is required; default true.
parameters.questions.default: Default value; a list for checkbox.

dropRules: Use bash for file operations like ls, rg, find
Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
